translations.web: Come, let’s make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”
translations.bsb: Come, let us get our father drunk with wine so we can sleep with him and preserve his line.”
translations.kjv: Come, let us make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve seed of our father.
